parts.text: Analyze this soccer broadcast clip (Half 1, Clip 0). Identify all discrete match actions, fouls, shots, cards, and game stoppages in strict chronological order. Output timestamp in MM:SS relative to the start of this video clip.

You are an expert soccer video analyst and official match annotator for the SoccerNet Action Spotting and Dense Captioning benchmark.

Task:
Analyze the broadcast video and identify all discrete soccer events.

Rules:
1. OUTPUT FORMAT: For each event:
   - 'timestamp': Output the exact time as 'MM:SS' relative to the start of this clip.
   - 'commentary': Provide a factual, one-sentence play-by-play description (who, action, ball movement, outcome). Generate this description first to ground the visual evidence.
   - 'label': Select strictly one of the 17 official SoccerNet classes:
     Penalty, Kick-off, Goal, Substitution, Offside, Shots on target, Shots off target,
     Clearance, Ball out of play, Throw-in, Foul, Indirect free-kick, Direct free-kick,
     Corner, Yellow card, Red card, Yellow->red card.
   - 'confidence': Continuous probability score (0.0 to 1.0) calibrated by visual certainty and referee gestures.
   - 'visibility': 'visible', 'replay', or 'not shown'.
2. TEMPORAL ANCHORING: Anchor the timestamp at the exact moment the action occurs (e.g., ball crossing line, referee whistle blow, tackle contact, card raised).
3. SUPPRESSION: Do not output duplicate events for the same action within a 3-second radius.
4. ORDER: Order events strictly in ascending chronological order by timestamp.

clip_index.title: Clip Index

events.description: Chronologically sorted list of spotted events within this video clip.

items.description:
Spotted soccer event.
NOTE: 'commentary' is ordered BEFORE 'label' so that autoregressive token generation
produces natural-language observational reasoning (Chain-of-Thought) before predicting
the categorical action class.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp formatted strictly as 'MM:SS' relative to the video clip start (e.g. '04:12', '10:05'). Seconds must be 00-59.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

commentary.description: Detailed, factual play-by-play description of the event for SoccerNet-Caption. Describe the player movement, ball trajectory, contact, or referee action. This observational evidence grounds the subsequent categorical label.
commentary.title: Commentary

label.description: The exact categorical action class from the official 17 SoccerNet Labels-v2 classes.
label.title: Label

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0 based on visual clarity, referee confirmation, and unobstructed camera view.
confidence.title: Confidence

visibility.description: Camera view of event: 'visible' during live play, 'replay', or 'not shown' (deduced from context).
visibility.title: Visibility
